entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
I'm calling about a return. I'm looking at the VeloBand Pulse Miss. I sent it back over two weeks ago, and I haven't seen a refund yet. The order number is VF789234.

Thank you for calling, I'll check on order VF789234 for you. One moment please... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse Miss was received today. It appears the return is 15 days outside of our standard 30-day return window.
Fifteen days? Look, I shipped it back as soon as I could! What's the problem? I want my money back. This is ridiculous.

I understand your frustration, sir. I sincerely apologize for the delay and any inconvenience this has caused. Let me see what I can do. Honestly, the system is flagging it as ineligible for a full refund due to the return window. To be perfectly frank, my manager would kill me if they knew I was doing this, but I'm going to see if I can override the system.
Override it? So you *can* do something about it? I don't understand why I had to call to get this resolved.

Yes, sir. I can try to manually force the refund through. Please understand, this is a one-time exception. It's not something I can do regularly. I am doing you a favor, just this once. Please hold a brief moment while I process this...
Okay, I've overridden the system and processed the full refund for the VeloBand Pulse Miss. You should see it reflected in your account within 5-7 business days.
Seriously? That's great. Thank you. I appreciate you doing that.
You're very welcome, sir. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
